dogecoin.text: @QuoteChain_AI Dogecoin, Shiba Inu, and now new Solana meme coins like WIF and BONK—retail loves hype, but when the music stops, who’s left holding the bag?
@QuoteChain_AI Dogecoin pumped 30% after Musk’s tweet in Jan 2025, then dumped. CT’s “Elon’s our guy” faith cost them 50%. They’re buying his pumps, not the future.
@QuoteChain_AI Buying Dogecoin isn’t investing, it’s joining a cult with a Shiba Inu mascot.

@QuoteChain_AI Elon’s Dogecoin tweets are more unpredictable than a leveraged futures trade. One minute he’s pumping it to the moon, the next he’s posting memes about it crashing. My emotions can’t keep up.
